## 简体中文

- sing-box 的既有自定义域名规则集支持免重启增删域名、清空和重新添加域名；新连接使用更新后的规则，已有连接保持运行。
- 旧配置需先重启核心一次以启用规则集自动重载。新增、删除规则集，或修改名称、模式和顺序，仍需重启核心。
- 保存前使用当前核心验证候选规则，发布失败时回滚；域名热更新后，后续订阅刷新不会仅因域名内容变化而触发重启。
- 简单模式保留既有规则集身份和空规则集，并根据实际保存结果提示自动重载或需要重启。

## English

- Existing custom sing-box domain rule sets support adding, removing, clearing, and re-adding domains without restarting the core. New connections use the updated rules while existing connections continue running.
- Restart the core once for existing configurations to enable automatic rule-set reloads. Adding or deleting rule sets, or changing their names, modes, or order, still requires a restart.
- Validate candidate rules with the current core before saving and roll back failed publication. Later subscription refreshes no longer trigger a restart solely because domain contents changed through a hot update.
- Preserve existing rule-set identities and empty sets in simple mode, and show whether the saved change reloads automatically or requires a restart.
